description: Renovate only updates GitHub Actions, on a schedule, and merges them into main without a PR once the required checks pass on the renovate/* branch. Every action is pinned to a commit hash with its release in a comment.

packageRules.description: anthropics/claude-code-action is released almost daily. In the shared group, it would change the branch on most runs, and a branch that changed during a run is not merged by that run: the other updates would wait behind it.
